# The Ruby extractor gets a resolvable specifier rather than a counted-only one, because
# this file has a second job: core -> db closes a loop against db/client.ts -> core/util.ts,
# which is the only dependency cycle in the tree. Kill the .rb extractor and both the edge
# and the cycle vanish.
require_relative '../db/client'

def reindex(raw_id)
  lookup(raw_id)
end
